error.notification.notificationDeliveryM.zh-CN: 通知工作状态已变化，当前写入未提交
error.notification.notificationDeliveryM.en: The notification job status changed. This write was not committed.

error.notification.channelDeliveryAccess.zh-CN: 发送记录不存在或无法访问。
error.notification.channelDeliveryAccess.en: The delivery record does not exist or is inaccessible.

error.notification.channelDeliveryCancel.zh-CN: 此接入仍有正在处理的通知，请稍后再删除。
error.notification.channelDeliveryCancel.en: This integration still has notifications being processed. Delete it later.

error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.zh-CN: 此发送记录不能再次尝试，请查看结果或创建新的通知。
error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.en: This delivery cannot be retried. Check its result or create a new notification.

error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.zh-CN: 此前请求可能已被平台接受，请确认能够接受重复通知后再试。
error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.en: The platform may have accepted the previous request. Only retry if duplicate notifications are acceptable.

error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.zh-CN: 此成员尚未绑定所选应用，请先完成绑定。
error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.en: This member has not linked the selected application. Complete the binding first.

error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.zh-CN: 请选择当前企业中的有效成员。
error.notification.channelDeliveryManage.en: Select an active member of the current organization.

error.notification.channelDeliveryStore..zh-CN: 通知发送记录在保存期间发生变化
error.notification.channelDeliveryStore..en: The notification delivery record changed while saving.

error.notification.channelDeliveryTransa.zh-CN: 已经开始的通知请求不能退回发送前等待
error.notification.channelDeliveryTransa.en: A notification request that has started cannot return to the pre-send queue.

error.notification.channelDeliveryTransa.zh-CN: 通知工作租约已变化，不能保存旧结果
error.notification.channelDeliveryTransa.en: The notification job lease changed. The old result cannot be saved.

error.notification.channelNotificationRo.zh-CN: 通知所选的企业接入不存在
error.notification.channelNotificationRo.en: The organization integration selected for the notification does not exist.

error.notification.channelNotificationRo.zh-CN: 同一批定时通知必须属于同一企业
error.notification.channelNotificationRo.en: Scheduled notifications in one batch must belong to the same organization.

error.notification.channelNotificationRo.zh-CN: 定时通知的接入记录已丢失
error.notification.channelNotificationRo.en: The scheduled notification integration record is missing.

error.notification.channelPayloadCodec.e.zh-CN: 通知请求内容无法保存
error.notification.channelPayloadCodec.e.en: The notification request content could not be saved.

error.notification.channelPayloadCodec.h.zh-CN: 通知请求内容无法校验
error.notification.channelPayloadCodec.h.en: The notification request content could not be verified.

error.notification.channelPayloadCodec.d.zh-CN: 已保存的通知请求无法读取
error.notification.channelPayloadCodec.d.en: The saved notification request could not be read.

error.notification.notificationCategoryC.zh-CN: 请选择已有的通知类别。

error.notification.notificationService.i.zh-CN: 请重新读取通知列表后再标记已读。
error.notification.notificationService.i.en: Reload the notification list before marking items as read.

error.notification.notificationService.i.zh-CN: 通知列表已变化，请重新打开列表。
error.notification.notificationService.i.en: The notification list has changed. Reopen it.

error.notification.notificationWriteServ.zh-CN: 通知接收成员的序号无法更新
error.notification.notificationWriteServ.en: The notification recipient sequence could not be updated.

error.notification.channelDeliveryStore..zh-CN: 上一次请求未保存最终结果，可能已被平台接受。
error.notification.channelDeliveryStore..en: The previous request has no saved final result and may have been accepted by the platform.

error.notification.channelDeliveryTransa.zh-CN: 此前请求可能已被平台接受；{0}
error.notification.channelDeliveryTransa.en: The platform may have accepted the previous request; {0}
The final result could not be confirmed.

error.notification.channelDeliveryWorker.zh-CN: 发送准备暂未完成，稍后会继续尝试。
error.notification.channelDeliveryWorker.en: Delivery preparation is incomplete and will be retried later.

error.notification.channelFailureNoticeS.zh-CN: 有一条渠道通知未能完成
平台是否已接受该通知暂时无法确认，请查看发送记录后处理。
error.notification.channelFailureNoticeS.en: We cannot confirm whether the platform accepted this notification. Check the delivery history before taking action.

error.notification.channelFailureNoticeS.zh-CN: 通知未能通过外部应用发送，请查看发送记录中的原因。
error.notification.channelFailureNoticeS.en: The notification could not be sent through the external app. Check the delivery history for the reason.

log.notification.notificationScheduling..zh-CN: 通知暂未保存，下次继续处理：工作编号={}
log.notification.notificationScheduling..en: Notification was not saved; processing will resume; jobId={}

log.notification.notificationScheduling..zh-CN: 通知队列暂时无法读取
log.notification.notificationScheduling..en: The notification queue could not be read

text.notification.channelDeliveryManagem.zh-CN: 人工再次尝试发送通知
管理员正在验证此应用的通知发送，请确认能够收到本条测试消息。
text.notification.channelDeliveryManagem.en: An administrator is testing notifications from this app. Please confirm that you received this message.

text.notification.channelDeliveryManagem.zh-CN: 排入企业接入测试通知

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 接收人已不在企业中或账号已停用。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The recipient has left the organization or the account is disabled.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 接收人已关闭此类自动通知。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The recipient disabled this type of automatic notification.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 发起人已无权向此成员发送通知。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The initiator no longer has permission to notify this member.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 创建人已停止本次操作，不再继续发送。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The creator stopped this operation. No further messages will be sent.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 此接入已停止发送通知。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: Notification delivery is disabled for this integration.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 应用密钥已更换，请重新创建通知。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The application secret changed. Create a new notification.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 接收人尚未绑定此应用账号。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The recipient has not linked an account for this application.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 接收人的账号绑定已变更，请重新创建通知。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The recipient's account binding changed. Create a new notification.

text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..zh-CN: 接收人已关闭此渠道的通知。
text.notification.channelDeliveryPolicy..en: The recipient disabled notifications for this channel.

text.notification.channelDeliveryStore.o.zh-CN: 此发送工作已被后续操作取代。
text.notification.channelDeliveryStore.o.en: This delivery job was replaced by a later operation.

text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.zh-CN: 通知发送已用尽本次允许的尝试次数。
text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.en: Notification delivery exhausted its allowed attempts.

text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.zh-CN: 通知发送或恢复次数已达到上限。
text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.en: The notification delivery or recovery attempt limit was reached.

text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.zh-CN: 此通知已超过发送有效期。
此前请求可能已被接受，已停止自动重试。
text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.en: The previous request may have been accepted. Automatic retries were stopped.

text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.zh-CN: 企业或通知当前不可用。
text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.en: The organization or notification is unavailable.

text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.zh-CN: 原发送内容不可用，不能继续发送。
text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.en: The original message content is unavailable. Delivery cannot continue.

text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.zh-CN: 在通知有效期内无法继续等待发送。
text.notification.channelDeliveryTransac.en: Delivery cannot wait any longer within this notification's validity period.

log.notification.channelDeliveryWorker.r.zh-CN: 通知发送工作暂时无法领取
log.notification.channelDeliveryWorker.r.en: Notification delivery work could not be claimed

text.notification.channelDeliveryWorker..zh-CN: 已达到此应用或接收人的发送频率，正在等待可发送时间。
text.notification.channelDeliveryWorker..en: This application or recipient reached its sending rate limit. Waiting until delivery is allowed.

text.notification.channelDeliveryWorker..en: The request may have been sent, but no result is confirmed.
